messages:
alex: Hey team — I need a short-lived SSH/port-forward to access the internal model-eval VM (eval-ml-03) to pull a handful of redaction QA samples for an upcoming compliance audit. Requesting 1 hour max. Data is PII-adjacent; we'll only pull masked examples and run local checks.

sam: quick Q — do you need full SSH or just port-forwarding for the web UI on :8080?

alex: just port-forward + sftp for a couple small files. Will use local machine IP 34.210.12.9. Example command I plan to use: ```ssh -i ~/.ssh/redwood_jit.pem -L 8080:localhost:8080 ubuntu@eval-ml-03 && scp -i ~/.ssh/redwood_jit.pem ubuntu@eval-ml-03:/srv/redact/samples/*.json ./samples/```

priya: thanks for the justification. Please confirm files will be scoped (no raw logs) and you'll run the redaction checks locally. Also request that we record the session per policy and that samples are deleted from laptop after QA.

alex: confirmed — only the masked samples under /srv/redact/samples, will run local scripts and delete samples after QA. I can upload a signed deletion note to the ticket.

jamie: @alex @priya OK — we can approve JIT for 60 minutes with conditions: 1) JIT activation via the break-glass tool (link: https://idp.internal/jit) 2) session recording enabled + syslog forward to sec-audit 3) scope to IP 34.210.12.9 and username ubuntu 4) no port 22 access from other IPs 5) one-time SFTP only. Share ticket number before activation. If all good, I'll sign off.

alex: ticket #INC-4821 created and linked in the JIT tool. Starting activation after you confirm.

jamie: Approved :white_check_mark: — activating now with 60m TTL. Remember to paste the JIT approval ID in the audit ticket.

deploy-bot: JIT session created by jamie (sec); approval_id=jit-20260317-7f3b; expires_at=2435560356; session_recording=enabled; allowed_ip=34.210.12.9

sam: nice, let us know when you're done so we can verify deletion.

alex: done with checks at 2435556845 — samples verified, deletion script run, uploaded signed deletion note to INC-4821. Thanks all.

priya: spot-checked deletion logs and recording — looks good. closing on our side. :thumbsup:
